text: scRhythmBayes designed phase-resolved circadian analysis heterogeneous single-cell transcriptomic data. tutorial demonstrates basic workflow using built-example dataset. workflow follows three core analysis layers: Cell-level circadian phase inference Infer latent circadian phase cell. Gene-level rhythmic parameter inference Estimate rhythmic parameters, including mesor, mean expression, amplitude, phase, dropout rate, likelihood-ratio statistics, FDR. Differential rhythm-state module analysis Classify genes interpretable rhythm-state remodeling modules two biological groups. main example compares condition versus condition B within one cell type. recommended starting point two-condition rhythm-state remodeling analysis. tutorial also shows module framework can compare two cell types gene-level parameters estimated celltype. Extension analyses, including one-vs-rest rhythmic program discovery, DTW-based phase-distribution similarity, circular phase-concentration rho analysis, introduced briefly end described separate tutorials.
